Convention.description: How a model's numbers are read: integer molecule counts and complete stochastic propensities.

ModelVersion.description: Schema tag of a model document.

Rate.description: Custom laws are complete propensities, not mass-action multipliers. All laws require sufficient reactants before firing (implemented in M1/M2).

oneOf.description: `mass_action`: c × Π binomial(x, ν) over the reactants, with coefficient c ≥ 0, so `2A` gives c·x(x−1)/2 and an empty reactant side gives c.
`hill_activation`: basal + vmax·xⁿ/(kⁿ + xⁿ), with x the regulator count; vmax, basal ≥ 0 and k, n > 0.

regulator.description: Species whose count x drives the law.

oneOf.description: `hill_repression`: basal + vmax·kⁿ/(kⁿ + xⁿ), with x the regulator count; vmax, basal ≥ 0 and k, n > 0.

regulator.description: Species whose count x drives the law.

oneOf.description: `michaelis_menten`: vmax·x/(km + x), with x the substrate count; vmax ≥ 0 and km > 0.

substrate.description: Species whose count enters the law.

Reaction.description: One reaction channel: stoichiometry by species name and a rate law.

products.description: Produced species and coefficients from 1 to 2147483647; omit zeros. An empty map is a sink.

reactants.description: Consumed species and coefficients from 1 to 2147483647; omit zeros. An empty map is a source. A channel can fire only while every reactant count covers its coefficient.

anyOf.description: A finite number used as given.
The name of an entry in the model's `parameters`; an unknown name is `CRN-E014`.

Scalar.description: A literal or the exact name of a model parameter; no string evaluation.

Species.description: One species: a unique name, its initial molecule count and an optional safety limit.

initial_count.description: Initial molecule count, a non-negative 64-bit integer; counts above 2^53 stay exact.

name.description: Identifier, unique among species and distinct from every parameter name.

population_limit.description: A safety stop, never a reflecting boundary or an FSP truncation bound. When present it is at least `initial_count`. An update that would exceed it is never applied; a stochastic replicate stops with `population_limit` instead.

description: A fixed reaction network: species with initial counts, named parameters and reactions with rate laws. Declaration order fixes every species and reaction index in results and analyses.

name.description: Model identifier: 1–64 ASCII letters, digits or underscores, not starting with a digit.

omega.description: Counts per chosen concentration unit. Does not rescale SSA coefficients.

parameters.description: Finite named values that rate laws reference by name; at most 16384. Names follow the identifier rules and must not collide with species names.

reactions.description: Reactions in declaration order, at most 65536; an empty list gives an absorbing model.

species.description: Species in declaration order, 1–4096 entries with unique names.
